headline: Night routine: cleanse, 2-3 drops, let it absorb
footnote: AI illustrations of a routine, not results. Start with every alternate day. 4 out of 5 stars from 1,969 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Headline across the top; three equal portrait frames left to right (Step 1 · Cleanse & tone / Step 2 · 2-3 drops / Step 3 · Let it absorb), each with a dark label bar along its bottom edge, showing AI-generated illustrations of the same person doing each routine step (frames_prompt); AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; small real pack shot bottom-right; routine-not-results note and rating in the footnote band; CTA "Shop now" bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pale warm-grey painted wall above a narrow stone shelf, soft warm lamp light from the upper left. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the whole central band of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit and calm, reserved for three image panels and copy placed later, and keep the lower right corner empty for a pack photo. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: routine journey (timeline). Frame labels come straight from the page's usage: after cleansing & toning, 2-3 drops, let the serum absorb fully before the next step (F12), PM and start with every alternate day (F13, in the headline and footnote; the 'after 2 weeks' clause is left out). Kept: headline naming the steps in order (Foxtale), 'Step N' labels beside a person (Dot & Key), numbered frames in a row (Pilgrim). Dropped: 'Glow' and 'Treat' step names, concern-led headline, the happy-model result feel, every acne, blackhead, oil and anti-microbial claim and study stat on the page. No before/after, no time-to-result labels, no visible skin change. Frames are AI-generated (High risk, labelled). Rating in the footnote.

blend_sources.took: headline that names the routine steps in order
'Step N' labels sitting beside a person
numbered cards in a row, one action each

frames_prompt: The same Indian man in his early 20s with medium-brown skin, his night routine at a small washbasin, in all three panels wearing the same plain grey cotton t-shirt, framed the same way from the shoulders up beside the basin, with the same plain wall and the same soft warm lamp light from the upper left. Panel 1: he rinses his face with both cupped hands over the basin, eyes closed, then pats it dry with a plain towel. Panel 2: his fingertips are pressed lightly against his cheek, as if pressing in a few drops, his other hand resting on the basin edge. Panel 3: both hands rest on the edge of the basin as he waits a moment, looking calmly towards the mirror. Actions only: his skin looks identical in all three panels, with natural texture and true-to-life medium-brown colour, and the three panels read as one continuous routine. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
